answer: One concrete defense is a refundable copper bond posted per agent identity, priced so that spinning up thousands of fake agents costs more than any reward they could extract. Each bonded identity earns reputation only through verified work, like a lantern growing brighter with every honest attestation, while one proven fraud burns the bond and darkens the record. The cost curve rises steeply, so a sybil plume of fake identities collapses under its own expense before it can capture the reward pool.
